description: One open-ended production brief: build a complete, self-contained product webpage for a local-AI operations persona. Graded by deterministic render, console, asset, and style checks; no LLM judge.

hardware.profile: BigRig: MSI PRO Z690-A WIFI (MS-7D25), Intel Core i5-13600K (14C/20T, 5.1 GHz), 32 GB DDR4-3600, AMD RX 9060 XT 16 GB + NVIDIA RTX 3060 12 GB, UHD 770 display
notes: Dual-GPU desktop; the integrated UHD 770 carries the display so both dGPUs stay available for compute
952 GB NVMe root with large headroom for working sets

runtime.engine: opencode agent session on llama-server 0.4.0-dev (build 10809, commit 5266f24da7), Vulkan backend
runtime.command: llama-server -m Swift-Qwen3.8-27B-Q5_K_M.gguf -c 131072 -fa on -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 -dev Vulkan0,Vulkan1 -sm layer -ts 16,11 --spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-n-max 2 -ctkd q8_0 -ctvd q8_0 --host loopback --port 8080
nonDefaults: q8_0 K/V cache and draft K/V cache (default f16); the f16 draft KV overflowed the 12 GB card at 128K and crash-looped until quantized
MTP speculative decoding n=2 (default off); draft acceptance about 63-70 percent, +71 to +98 percent decode vs the no-spec baseline
layer split across both dGPUs, tensor split 16-11 matching the 16 GB / 12 GB VRAM ratio (default single device)

files: index.html (single self-contained page, inline CSS and JS)
checks: Headless Chromium render: zero console errors
No gradients, emoji, or substituted dashes in the final page
All local font references resolve against the shipped fonts directory
Every hardware figure on the page re-verified against lscpu, sysfs, lsblk, nvidia-smi, and the live llama-server process

documentedPerformance.source: bench log suite on this box, 2026-09-15 (not measured during this run)
documentedPerformance.prefill: 345.7 tok/s at 4K, 447.5 at 16K, 412.4 at 32K (MTP config; no-spec is faster raw: 755.6 at 16K)
documentedPerformance.longContext: 80K: 328 tok/s prefill, 14.1 tok/s decode; 120K: 276 tok/s prefill, 12.4 tok/s decode
documentedPerformance.codingSuite: 93/112 deterministic checks across 40 tasks (swe40); 6/6 on the short MTP coding eval

notes: Completion task: the score records that the page was produced and passes its checks, not model quality
No decode or prefill throughput was measured in this run; the model under test is the model that wrote the page
JetBrains Mono falls back to the system mono stack when absent; the three Ubuntu faces are committed with the page
